evidence_tier: REAL. Block C: temper collapse on the gated adversarial-kappa environment (gates ALL PASS at 4bab082db8eba24c), 300 trials per cell, paired-difference form throughout.
question: Does the repaired identity predict the collapse slope in a world built to break it? Design-audit kappa_pred spans 0.78 to 2.42 across the temper cells (mean 1.304), far outside the 0.85 to 1.25 range of the five prior environments.

predictions.PC-1: Pooled temper paired-difference slope in [1.22, 1.82]. Derivation, registered: the Block A cross-cell regression coefficient 1.167 applied to the audit mean kappa_pred 1.304 gives 1.522; the window is +/- 0.30, widened from the TOST margin by the B2-measured gap spread (0.19 to 0.29).
predictions.PC-2: THE SHARP ONE: within this single environment (so the environment-label confound of Block A A3 vanishes), the through-origin regression of per-cell measured kappa (paired difference / aligned error) on per-cell kappa_pred over the guarded cells has slope in [0.9, 1.4] and R2 >= 0.5. If this holds, kappa is computable per cell from calibration draws and the constancy claim's replacement survives its adversarial test; the cross-environment residue of A3 then reads as a between-family effect, not a failure of the local formula.
predictions.PC-3: Oracle consistent in all 16 cells, with large conservatism (audit: -0.0133) consistent with the F17 intercept mechanism on a coarse impure band.
predictions.PC-4: The gamma = 0 endpoint at the top beta realizes excess near the design probe's unweighted decay (+0.109 at 30 trials, disclosed), confirming the environment does what it was built to do.

falsifiers.PC-1/2: Registered outcome logic per NEXT_BLOCK.md: prediction hits, then constancy was five similar worlds and the correct claim is kappa computable, slope predicted; prediction misses, then the identity's kappa is incomplete and the miss localizes what it omits (the candidate omissions, in order: threshold-distance saturation from A1, between-family structure from B2/B3, finite-difference window bias). There is no outcome in which the experiment is wasted, and no version of the old constancy claim survives it.
falsifiers.PC-4: A tame gamma = 0 endpoint means the design audit overstated the band mechanism; re-audit before interpreting the slopes.

decision_rule: Pooled slope through origin on paired differences over the 16 cells; per-cell regression restricted to the registered guards (abs(a) >= 0.003, slope_what >= 0.02); kappa_pred computed inside the battery itself at the registered h = 0.05, so prediction and measurement share draws trial-by-trial.
notes: Design-phase audits, disclosed and never citable: two rejected designs (kappa_pred 1.022 with no decay; 1.066 with linear band error) preceded the frozen threshold-gated design (kappa_pred cells 0.78 to 2.42, G3 lift +0.048, wrong 0.115, unweighted 0.209 at the top beta, 30 to 60 trial probes). The design iterations are part of the record: making kappa adversarial required exactly the band-concentration mechanism the identity names, which is itself weak evidence the identity has the right variables.

verdicts.PC-1: MISS: pooled slope 2.032 +/- 0.181, above [1.22, 1.82]. The cross-environment coefficient 1.167 does not transfer as a universal amplification; the pooled fit is also dominated by the extreme gamma = 0 cell (a = +0.043, pd = +0.121, measured kappa 2.81 vs kappa_pred 2.49).
verdicts.PC-2: CONFIRMED, and it is the block's central positive result: within the adversarial environment, per-cell measured kappa regressed on per-cell kappa_pred gives slope 1.243 +/- 0.054 with R2 = 0.780 over a 3x kappa_pred range (0.75 to 2.49). kappa IS computable per cell from calibration draws up to a multiplicative amplification, and the computable part carried the within-world variation in a world built to maximize it. Per the registered outcome logic, the constancy claim's replacement survives its adversarial test in the per-cell form and fails in the pooled-transfer form; the residual is the amplification factor m, measured family-invariant at fixed alpha (1.24 spike, 1.19 tree-claims, 1.18 logit-claims) and alpha-dependent (1.61 at alpha 0.05), which is the block's named open problem.
verdicts.PC-3: CONFIRMED with an instrumentation caveat filed honestly: the runner stored per-cell oracle means but not per-cell oracle SEs; every cell's mean oracle excess is at most -0.0081 (most negative -0.0167), which at 300-trial SEs near 0.002 puts mean + 1.645 SE below alpha + 0.005 in every cell by a wide margin. Conservatism is large, as registered for a coarse impure band.
verdicts.PC-4: CONFIRMED: the gamma = 0 top endpoint realized pd = +0.1208 against the disclosed +0.109 probe; the environment does what it was built to do.
